title: Effects of racemic anisodamine in combination with orthokeratology and defocus incorporated multiple segment spectacle lenses for myopia control in adolescents

groups.description: Group A: Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses alone; 35 children, 70 eyes (Table 1); Chongqing, China
Group B: orthokeratology lenses alone; 38 children, 72 eyes (Table 1); Chongqing, China

Group C: DIMS spectacle lenses combined with racemic anisodamine eye drops (concentration and regimen not stated); 35 children, 70 eyes (Table 1); 'other' because racemic anisodamine is not one of the listed treatments, so the protocol's 'combination' (two listed treatments) does not apply
Group D: orthokeratology lenses combined with racemic anisodamine eye drops (concentration and regimen not stated); 37 children, 68 eyes (Table 1); 'other' for the same reason as Group C

series.notes: mean ± SD as printed in Table 2 (both eyes of each child pooled; eye counts in the column header, the same header n for every visit, no per-visit n reported); unit mm from Table 1 row 'Axial length (mm)'; IOLMaster 500; retrospective cohort; n = 70 eyes of 35 children

mean ± SD as printed in Table 2 (both eyes of each child pooled; eye counts in the column header, the same header n for every visit, no per-visit n reported); unit mm from Table 1 row 'Axial length (mm)'; IOLMaster 500; retrospective cohort; n = 72 eyes of 38 children

mean ± SD as printed in Table 2 (both eyes of each child pooled; eye counts in the column header, the same header n for every visit, no per-visit n reported); unit mm from Table 1 row 'Axial length (mm)'; IOLMaster 500; retrospective cohort; n = 70 eyes of 35 children

mean ± SD as printed in Table 2 (both eyes of each child pooled; eye counts in the column header, the same header n for every visit, no per-visit n reported); unit mm from Table 1 row 'Axial length (mm)'; IOLMaster 500; retrospective cohort; n = 68 eyes of 37 children

exclusions.what: Table 3 (axial elongation at 3, 6 and 12 months, all four groups)
exclusions.reason: change series of the same groups; the protocol uses the absolute series of Table 2 when both are given
baseline axial length duplicated by the Table 2 baseline row, which is cited instead

exclusions.what: F and P columns of Tables 1-3
exclusions.reason: test statistics and p-values are not admissible values

exclusions.what: Tables 4 and 5 (spherical equivalent refraction and its change)
exclusions.reason: refraction is not axial length (protocol inclusion 1)

notes: Retrospective cohort (Discussion: 'as a retrospective study'), July 2022 to October 2023, First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical and Pharmaceutical College, China; groups by treatment modality, not randomised.

The stated inclusion criteria do not require the 12-month visit; the eye counts tabulated at every visit equal the included counts of Table 1 and no attrition is reported, so the groups are used as tabulated (not treated as a complete-case set).
Both eyes of each child were analysed together (Discussion); the tables pool both eyes (or one eye of some children in Groups B and D), used as tabulated (protocol inclusion 7).
Follow-up visits at 3, 6 and 12 months after baseline; axial length by IOLMaster 500 (mean of at least five measurements per eye).
Corneal curvature and spherical equivalent refraction are tabulated (Tables 1, 4, 5) and are not extracted.
